title: Mecka AI nears $500M valuation in Sequoia-led deal amid rush for robot training data
summary: While Mecka AI hasn’t publicly disclosed its customer list, many robotics companies and AI labs rely on real-world data captured through this “egocentric” approach, alongside other physical data collection methods like teleoperation, to build their models.
